|translation='''Title:''' Blizzard 1

'''Card text:''' Can carry 2 pilots and 8 passengers. Immune to attrition &lt; 4. When using an AT-AT Laser Cannon to attempt Target The Main Generator, add 1 to the total.

'''Lore:''' General Veers' AT-AT. Enclosed. Has advanced communications equipment built in. Equipped with an experimental targeting system.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names the weapon AT-ATレーザー砲 (“AT-AT Laser Cannon”), where the original English names [[AT-AT Cannon]].
